# HTA & Associates

> Strategic legal intelligence, advocacy and consulting for media, law and reputation. New York and Los Angeles. Private consultations by appointment. HTA & Associates is not a law firm; legal services are provided only through independently licensed attorneys.

- [Press & Newsroom](https://htaassociates.com/newsroom.html): press releases and headlines desk
